A white and blue Mazda RX-7 IMSA GTO (FC) from 1990, marked with the number 1 and sponsor decals, powers down a racetrack. Its aerodynamic silhouette, prominent rear wing, and gold racing wheels underscore its IMSA GTO racing heritage. Goodyear tire branding and PIAA logos further highlight its competition-ready setup.
